title.narrative: Innovation interventions: testing what works for supporting people with disabilities and generating evidence of effectiveness

description.narrative: The project is developing innovative approaches to including people with disabilities in development projects, testing what has and hasn't work and sharing the resulting evidence. The interventions run in Nigeria, Kenya, Tanzania, Bangladesh and Nepal.
